description: This file is a plugin for CKEditor, specifically implementing table tools such as cell merging, splitting, inserting, deleting, and building table maps. It defines functions for manipulating table cells and rows, and registers commands and menu items for table editing within CKEditor.

methods.name: removeRawAttribute
methods.description: Removes a raw attribute from a node, handling IE environment differently.

methods.name: getSelectedCells
methods.description: Returns the table cells currently selected in the editor.

methods.name: getFocusElementAfterDelCells
methods.description: Determines the focus element after deleting selected cells.

methods.name: clearRow
methods.description: Clears all cells in a table row.

methods.name: insertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new row before or after the selected row.

methods.name: deleteRows
methods.description: Deletes selected rows or a specific row element.

methods.name: insertColumn
methods.description: Inserts a new column before or after the selected cell.

methods.name: getFocusElementAfterDelCols
methods.description: Determines the focus element after deleting columns.

methods.name: deleteColumns
methods.description: Deletes selected columns or a specific column.

methods.name: insertCell
methods.description: Inserts a new cell before or after the selected cell.

methods.name: deleteCells
methods.description: Deletes selected cells or a specific cell.

methods.name: trimCell
methods.description: Removes filler and trims a table cell.

methods.name: placeCursorInCell
methods.description: Places the cursor at the start or end of a cell.

methods.name: cellInRow
methods.description: Finds a cell in a row by index or returns the row.

methods.name: cellInCol
methods.description: Finds a cell in a column by index or returns the column.

methods.name: mergeCells
methods.description: Merges selected cells in a table, with options for direction and detection.

methods.name: verticalSplitCell
methods.description: Splits a cell vertically into two.

methods.name: horizontalSplitCell
methods.description: Splits a cell horizontally into two.
